verdict.rationale: The only retention-related evidence is that paste history can optionally be saved to disk, which is a product-owned choice about whether one data type persists. Nothing covers deleting data or retention for other data, such as shell-integration command history, session restoration state or AI chat contents. The AI plugin's separate-component design concerns network transmission, not retention, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented deletion/clear-history controls, retention settings for command history, scrollback and restored sessions, AI-data retention policy, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You can even opt to have the history saved to disk so it will never be lost.
